configuration.budget_count: floor(fraction * unique development pairs); fitting and validation both included
configuration.target_balancing: Greedily minimize (maximum endpoint acquired degree, sum endpoint acquired degrees, seeded lexical-rank tie breaker). Update both endpoint degrees after each acquisition. No outcomes inspected.
configuration.unavailable: Zero: pair-supervised models unavailable. Positive: fewer than 12 unique acquired pairs or fewer than four identities in any required inner train/validation partition is unavailable; no extra labels or replacement seed.
configuration.selection: Base/historical candidate reuse unchanged 16-entry menu and rotating historical inner folds. Neural penalty/epoch selected on development only, then refit for selected epoch. Guard uses three grouped OOF expert fits, each with its own nested selection; gate penalty/epoch selected on a separate deterministic partition of OOF development predictions, then refit.
configuration.checkpoint_role: frozen outer evaluation only; no all-development deployment refit
configuration.claim_scope: Exposed-source retrospective observed-single nominal-pair prediction. No biological gate, interaction discovery, noise ceiling, calibrated uncertainty, prospective assay savings or independent-culture confirmation.
